findings.text: wall_distance measures each promoted node's distance to the nearest wall VERTEX with np.linalg.norm, not to the wall polyline, and so bypasses nova.equilibrium.boundary_comparison._point_to_segment_distances, which brief.md's done-when item 1 requires 'for every point-to-curve distance'. The device wall here is one unit of 37 vertices (measure-8.json wall_units), so the substitution is not cosmetic: recomputing the 22 lower-pocket nodes with the owner gives 21.9 to 191.3 mm against the receipt's 22.3 to 191.3 mm, and 15 of the 22 nodes are overstated, by up to 100.8 mm (node 136 reads 123.3 mm from the wall in lower-pocket.json and is 22.5 mm from it). The fragment prints that field to argue the pocket is wall-bounded at promoted-nodes-xpoint-angles.html:158.

assert_inside is called with `labelled`, and `labelled` receives exactly one text artist (the zoom leader's share of the legend and the tick text are never registered), so the pairwise-overlap clause at render_angles.py:80-85 compares one box against nothing and can never fire; the manifest's claim that the legibility guard refuses labels that overlap is true of the mechanism and not of the call site, and the guard would pass a figure whose branch labels collided.

pair_blocks selects a branch's partner by |reach_m - reach_m| but reports shift_deg as min() of the angular differences over every image branch (angles_at_null.py:438-450), so the printed shift need not belong to the image bearing printed beside it; the four rows of the fragment's branch table coincide by luck on this data and the table is not self-consistent by construction.

baseline_suite is filed as not run with completed:false and a stated reason that a base worktree cannot be created under the fence, but /work/projects/imas_gpu/sophelio/evidence/promoted-nodes-xpoint-angles/baseline-gate-2fd5d5b58.log (written 11:37, after the manifest) records a detached base checkout at 2fd5d5b58 running the same pytest and ending EXIT=0 with one passed; the record's reason is contradicted by a log it does not cite, so the delta is readable but the field is wrong.

no log exists for the run that produced this receipt (10:56), and it is the receipt behind every asymptote, chord and arc length in the fragment; the other measurements carry measure-8-gate-receipt.log and pocket-gate.log, and brief.md's job constraint asks for the run's log on disk, so the primary angle table's provenance is a file mtime rather than a recorded exit status.
